Simple Process

How It Works

Buying or selling Bitcoin at our BTMs is simple and straightforward.

01

Walk Up to a BTM

Find the nearest BitcoinVN BTM location and approach the machine. No appointment needed.

02

Select "Buy Bitcoin"

Tap the Buy option on the screen. You'll see the current Bitcoin price displayed in VND.

03

Scan Your Wallet or Get a Paper Wallet

Scan the QR code of your existing Bitcoin wallet, or let the machine generate a paper wallet for you.

04

Insert Cash

Feed your VND bills into the machine. The screen will display the corresponding Bitcoin amount in real time.

05

Confirm & Receive Bitcoin

Confirm the transaction and your Bitcoin is sent instantly to your wallet with a real-time tracking link.

01

Walk Up to a BTM

Visit any BitcoinVN BTM location. All machines support both buying and selling Bitcoin.

02

Select "Sell Bitcoin"

Tap the Sell option on the screen. The machine will display the current sell rate in VND.

03

Enter Amount & Send Bitcoin

Enter how much VND you want to receive. The machine will display a QR code — send your Bitcoin to that address.

04

Wait for Confirmation

The machine will wait for blockchain confirmation. You can use the pre-sell option to speed this up.

05

Collect Your Cash

Once confirmed, the machine dispenses your VND cash. It's that simple.

Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

A Bitcoin ATM (or BTM) is a self-service cryptocurrency kiosk that allows you to buy and sell Bitcoin using cash. It works similarly to a regular ATM, but instead of dispensing cash from your bank account, it lets you exchange cash for Bitcoin and vice versa.

BitcoinVN BTMs offer the fastest and most private way to buy and sell Bitcoin in Vietnam. No bank account is needed and transactions are completed in minutes. We've been operating since 2014, making us the most established Bitcoin service in Vietnam.

No. BitcoinVN BTMs do not require KYC verification. You can buy and sell Bitcoin privately without providing identification documents. Your financial privacy is respected.

There are currently no transaction limits on our BTMs. You can buy or sell as much Bitcoin as you need in a single transaction.

Our fee structure is competitive and transparent. The price displayed on the BTM screen includes all fees — what you see is what you get. No hidden charges or surprise deductions.

While Bitcoin is not recognized as legal tender in Vietnam, owning and trading Bitcoin is not illegal. BitcoinVN has been a legally registered and operating business in Vietnam since 2013.

We post real-time BTM status updates on our Telegram channel and Facebook page. Follow us for the latest availability information.

No problem! Our BTMs can generate a paper wallet for you during the purchase. You'll receive a printed paper with your Bitcoin wallet address and private key. We recommend transferring the funds to a secure digital wallet afterwards.

Due to recent domestic telecom changes, SMS delivery for OTP codes may be affected. Please contact our support team via Telegram or Facebook and we'll help you complete your transaction.

Yes! If you prefer to buy Bitcoin online, visit bitcoinvn.io to use our online exchange service. Bank transfers and other payment methods are available.
